confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, beer, and cocktail estimates use Lugano cost-of-living price indexes and an approximate CHF-to-USD conversion. Wine is estimated from its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic and especially uncertain because they vary by season and availability.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Lugano-specific price indexes; accommodation uses general knowledge of high-cost Swiss and Ticino lakeside visitor cities without live listing research.
